headline: A federal law names a Postal Service building in Port Salerno, Florida, after Joseph Bullock.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 4755 Southeast Dixie Highway in Port Salerno, Florida, as the Joseph Bullock Post Office Building. It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 5, 2021.
